IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Consumer Protection & Housing.

Bill.BriefDescription: Making an appropriation to the mobile home park relocation fund.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making an appropriation to the mobile home parkrelocation fund; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The sum of four million dollars isappropriated for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2007, from the generalfund to the mobile home park relocation fund, to be used for payment ofmobile home relocation expenses under the mobile home relocationassistance program.
